name: Farmhouse Cheese
description:
A mild pressed cow-milk cheese with a pale interior and a simple cloth-marked rind. It is cut from the wheel for the common table.

Sold as one quarter-pound portion of cheese. Weight includes light disposable wrapping or tying where needed; reusable bags, vessels and drinking water are separate. Partial use is tracked manually.
